text: Every capture tool takes a picture. Specimen records the motion.
Like ink that follows your cursor.
Specimen moves its own cursor over every section, and records what the page does back.
It finds the ink, and times the fade. Seven hundred seventy-five milliseconds.
It even reads the page's own shader code.
Every hover and scroll becomes code, matched to the recording.
Paste into Figma, and the hover is already animated.
Open After Effects, and it's keyframed.
Your coding agent gets every value, as text.
